concerns.location: tasks.md:Dependencies and requirement coverage vs spec.md:Assumptions
concerns.text: Spec assumption promises collinearity 'will be diagnosed via variance-inflation factors', but no task computes or records VIF diagnostics. T009 only mentions the collinearity caveat descriptively in prose. Add a task (or extend T004/T006) to compute VIF among the three composition predictors and record the values in a results artifact.

concerns.location: tasks.md:T003/T004 vs spec.md:Edge Cases (Non-stationary Sampling) and FR-002
concerns.text: Spec edge case: 'extreme gaps (>6 h) trigger a warning and are excluded from correlation calculations.' No task defines how >6 h gaps are represented in synced.csv or excluded from the correlation engine. T003 asserts 'no NaNs' while T004 runs correlations on the full series — the exclusion rule for long gaps has no covering task, making the no-NaN assertion and the exclusion requirement jointly unsatisfiable on real 23-year data.

The plan's contracts/ directory includes output.schema.yaml, but no task validates any artifact against it; T004/T010 reference only analysis_schema.schema.yaml and dataset.schema.yaml. The orphan contract uses conflicting field names (composition_param/significant/effect_size_large) — either add a task that reconciles/retires it or a validation task, so every plan contract element has a covering task.
